label_use: OFFLINE EVALUATION ONLY - never load into pipelines, prompts, retrieval or features

S1_cart_seal_wear.cause: Worn inlet seal on cart FITC-B2 causing a growing gas leak during integrity tests; fixed by corrective work order replacing the seal.

S2_bad_filter_lot.cause: Filter capsule lot VL2-0719 from V-FLT-02 had a membrane defect; elevated PUPSIT flow on every cart that used it, re-testing does not help.

S3_incomplete_wetting.cause: Short manual wetting time leaves the membrane partly dry; first pre-IT attempt fails high, passes after re-wetting. Not a real defect.

S4_autoclave_overtemp.cause: Autoclave AC-02 temperature controller overshoot damaged filter membranes during sterilization: pre-IT normal, PUPSIT high. Lines B and C.

S5_sensor_drift.cause: Flow/pressure transducer on cart FITC-C1 drifting low; reported flows decrease over time until recalibration (PMCAL). Risk: masks real failures.

S6_warm_room.cause: HVAC adjustment raised line A room temperature; diffusion flows rise slightly but stay in spec. Expected behaviour, not a fault.

S7_tyvek_gripper_wear.cause: Vacuum cups on Tyvek removal robot TRR-A wearing out; rising lid removal alarms and downtime, no product impact. Fixed by CM work order.

S8_filler_needle_underfill.cause: Dosing pump for needle 7 on FILLER-B wearing; fill weight drifts low. Overlaps in time with S1 but is unrelated to the filter cart.

S9_vacuum_pump_degradation.cause: Vacuum pump VAC-A at the line A stoppering station losing capacity; weaker vacuum and more variable plunger depth until PM service.

RH1_new_lot_coincidence.cause: New filter lot introduced around the start of S1. Used on lines A and B with normal results everywhere except FITC-B2 - the lot is NOT the cause.
